This plot is my perennial garden — I keep it close to the house and it has been there for many years. I do not buy fertilizer from the cooperative for this plot because the trees and enset have been growing well with the manure from my animals, and cash is tight. I weed and tend it mostly with my own hands and the help of my family; the work is spread across the year rather than all at once like teff or wheat. I did not plant new seed this season because the perennials are already established, and I do not spray chemicals on what my family eats.
